clusters.pick_reason: PR #2450 wraps each individual read_stream_writer.send() call in a try/except that returns early, which is the correct fix for the race: once the stream is closed, the loop should stop immediately rather than continuing to process lines. PR #2456 only adds BrokenResourceError to the outer except clause, so a broken stream mid-loop still propagates through the inner send() calls before being caught — a less complete fix. PR #2456's encoding_error_handler default change (strict→replace) is orthogonal and can be applied separately.

members.title: fix: don't send a response for cancelled requests
members.author: Zelys-DFKH
members.reason: [llm] cluster primary: Both PRs modify RequestResponder.cancel() in session.py to fix the same protocol-compliance gap: when a request is cancelled, the current code sends an error response, which is incorrect. PR #2493 removes that error-response send entirely (citing the MCP spec: 'receivers must not send a response for a cancelled request'). PR #2514 removes the same error-response send and replaces it with a CancelledNotification send. The two diffs conflict directly on the same lines of cancel(). (2 PRs)
